actual: The Basics step has only Program Name, Sport, Age group and Description (optional) — no 'Age at enrollment' control, no youngest/oldest fields, no age-rule toggle, for any age group. Checked with Under 13 selected (the group covering age 12, used in place of the non-existent 'Under 12') and with Adult selected; a page search for 'Age at enrollment' found nothing. So the oldest-12 refusal ('The oldest age can't go past 11.'), the oldest-11 save and the Adult youngest-18/no-oldest save could not be tested. Note: no 'Under 12' age group exists at all on dev (Settings › Age groups lists Under 9/11/13/15/17/Adult; the page's own text uses 'Under 12' only as an example) — the workbook's 'Under 12' group and its cap of 11 match no group on dev. Step 1 of PRG-044 passes: no age group is refused with 'Fix 1 thing before you continue.' / 'Choose who this program is for.'
expected: Basics offers an 'Age at enrollment' rule: youngest/oldest ages, with the oldest capped by the age group ("The oldest age can't go past 11.").
steps: Start a new program and press Next with no age group.
Pick Under 12, turn on 'Age at enrollment', set youngest 8 and oldest 12, press Next.
Start an Adult program, turn the rule on with youngest 18 and oldest empty.
title: PRG-044: no 'Age at enrollment' control on Basics — the age-rule feature (QXR-660) is absent
